settings.title: Settings
settings.app_info_desc:
Mandala Onsil is an offline healing app that safely keeps your data on your device without requiring an account.

If you delete the app or switch devices, your journals and flower collection may not be recoverable.

Purchased content can always be restored through Google Play at no additional cost.
